inference.summary: llama.cpp with CUDA 12.x for these architectures: CUDA 13 cannot build for them.
inference.notes: No tensor cores before Volta: prompt processing is slower than on newer cards, generation is bandwidth-bound and holds up well. Multi-GPU boards (four GPUs on one card) split a model with --split-mode layer.

retraining.summary: PyTorch from the CUDA 12.6 wheels, the last with kernels for compute 5.0–6.1; LoRA in fp32 (no bfloat16).
retraining.notes: bitsandbytes 4-bit (QLoRA) is not reliable below compute 7.5: train a LoRA on an fp16/fp32 base instead.
